programs.title: Associative Memory (conditioning simulation)
printedEvidence: MINIVAC is programmed so that if pushbuttons 1, 2 or 3 are pushed separately lights 1, 2 or 3 respectively will come on.
Push pushbuttons 1, 2 and 3 individually - each turns on the single light associated with it.
From now on, pushing either of the associated pushbuttons will turn on both of the associated lights.
Pushing all three together makes any one of them turn on all three lights.
programs.printedUnprinted: Lamp states after release, light 1 when pushed alone after the 2+3 association, and any lamp state after the 'forget' button (pushbutton 6) are not printed; the page says only 'The computer is once again ready to "learn" associations.'

programs.title: The Philosophic Tug of War
printedEvidence: The rotary switch knob turns counterclockwise (towards 9) if pushbuttons 1 and 6 are in the same position (both up or both down).
It turns clockwise (towards 7) if pushbuttons 1 and 6 are in different positions.
Dial stops at 9 -> player 1 wins. Dial stops at 7 -> player 2 wins.
programs.printedUnprinted: Dial position over time is derived, and the printed rotation words contradict the panel's dial sense (unresolved).

programs.title: The Mind Reading Trick
printedEvidence: A. Is the number greater than 3?
B. When the number is divided by 4, is the remainder greater than 1?
C. Is the number odd?
If the answer to question A is YES, move slide switch 4 to the LEFT.
If the answer to question A is NO, move slide switch 4 to the RIGHT.
If the answer to question B is YES, move slide switch 5 to the LEFT.
If the answer to question B is NO, move slide switch 5 to the RIGHT.
If the answer to question C is YES, move slide switch 6 to the LEFT.
If the answer to question C is NO, move slide switch 6 to the RIGHT.
After the replies to the questions have been indicated, push pushbutton 6. The pointer knob of the rotary switch will turn to the number your friend had in mind.
programs.printedUnprinted: The p.58 name variation's inputs need outside knowledge ('Is the name a boy's name?') and are not asserted; the page names no lamp or relay behaviour.
